component.name: Atomic Bomberman
component.summary: Classic Bomberman battles for up to ten players

description.p: A native Rust reconstruction of Interplay's 1997 Atomic Bomberman. Play local, LAN and private online battles with up to ten players and bots.
Choose from eleven arenas and sixty-eight schemes, with teams, powerups, diseases, rematches and optional HD graphics. Keyboard and gamepad controls are supported.

screenshot.caption: Ten-player battle in Classic graphics mode
